basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Bhopal Technical Coordinator Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Bhopal will hold a walk-in interview on 17 November 2026; eligible candidates should report by 9:30 am at Lecture Theatre 1, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Bhawan, AIIMS Bhopal. The walk-in is for 1 post of Technical Coordinator (I) (UR) on a purely contractual basis at the Centre of Excellence (CoE) for Rare Diseases, AIIMS Bhopal, under the National Policy for Rare Diseases (NPRD), 2021 of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (MoHFW), Government of India, with a consolidated pay of ₹60,000 per month and no application fee.

age_limit.details: The age limit is up to 45 years (as on the closing date of application). Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC candidates and for departmental candidates (including projects), in accordance with the instructions issued by the Central Government/MoHFW guidelines from time to time. The relaxation is subject to submission of the concerned document for the category along with the original application.

qualification.details: There is one post of Technical Coordinator (I), reserved as UR. The minimum essential qualification is a Master's degree in public health / Community Medicine / Health Management / Hospital Management / Public Health Informatics and related subjects OR MSW or equivalent from a recognized university, with at least 5 years' experience of working in the Public Health Sector. | The notice also requires familiarity with Public Health Systems (Rare Diseases) and Government Health Schemes. The prescribed qualification is the minimum, and merely possessing it does not entitle a candidate to selection. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post. | The age limit is up to 45 years (as on the closing date of application). Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC candidates and for departmental candidates (including projects), in accordance with the instructions issued by the Central Government/MoHFW guidelines from time to time. The relaxation is subject to submission of the concerned document for the category along with the original application. | Pay: ₹60,000/- per month (consolidated). Duration: one year, extendable as per the requirement of the CoE, subject to fund availability under NPRD, 2021. The engagement is purely contractual and time-bound; no permanent position shall be created and there will be no liability for regularization or absorption. The appointment is made from the human resource support sanctioned to the CoE and gives no right to appointment within the sanctioned staff strength of AIIMS Bhopal or MoHFW, New Delhi. MoHFW has no employer-employee relationship with the engaged Technical Coordinator. The contract expires automatically on completion of the period unless renewed with mutual consent, and can be terminated by either side with 30 days' notice or salary in lieu thereof. Leave is governed by the AIIMS Bhopal leave policy for extramural/short-term research projects; no hostel or other accommodation will be provided. The appointee can be posted anywhere as per the requirement of the CoE, including rural areas/field sites. Private practice of any type is prohibited.

content_sections.heading: About the Centre of Excellence for Rare Diseases
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal is located at Saket Nagar, Bhopal (MP) 462020. The Technical Coordinator (I) will work at its Centre of Excellence for Rare Diseases, which functions under the National Policy for Rare Diseases (NPRD), 2021 of MoHFW. The post will report to the Nodal Officer of the CoE, Dr. Bhavna Dhingra, Professor and I/C Head, Department of Medical Genetics, AIIMS Bhopal.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There is one post of Technical Coordinator (I), reserved as UR. The minimum essential qualification is a Master's degree in public health / Community Medicine / Health Management / Hospital Management / Public Health Informatics and related subjects OR MSW or equivalent from a recognized university, with at least 5 years' experience of working in the Public Health Sector. The notice also requires familiarity with Public Health Systems (Rare Diseases) and Government Health Schemes. The prescribed qualification is the minimum, and merely possessing it does not entitle a candidate to selection. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post. The age limit is up to 45 years (as on the closing date of application). Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC candidates and for departmental candidates (including projects), in accordance with the instructions issued by the Central Government/MoHFW guidelines from time to time. The relaxation is subject to submission of the concerned document for the category along with the original application. Pay: ₹60,000/- per month (consolidated). Duration: one year, extendable as per the requirement of the CoE, subject to fund availability under NPRD, 2021. The engagement is purely contractual and time-bound; no permanent position shall be created and there will be no liability for regularization or absorption. The appointment is made from the human resource support sanctioned to the CoE and gives no right to appointment within the sanctioned staff strength of AIIMS Bhopal or MoHFW, New Delhi. MoHFW has no employer-employee relationship with the engaged Technical Coordinator. The contract expires automatically on completion of the period unless renewed with mutual consent, and can be terminated by either side with 30 days' notice or salary in lieu thereof. Leave is governed by the AIIMS Bhopal leave policy for extramural/short-term research projects; no hostel or other accommodation will be provided. The appointee can be posted anywhere as per the requirement of the CoE, including rural areas/field sites. Private practice of any type is prohibited.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Act as a focal point for the Rare Diseases Clinic at the CoE. Provide technical and strategic support for planning, coordination and implementation of rare disease-related activities. Coordinate with clinical departments for diagnosis, investigations and formulation of treatment plans. Facilitate documentation, application review and approval processes for patient support. Liaise with MoHFW, State Governments and other stakeholders for fund disbursement and compliance. Coordinate with the spokes in matters of proposals for equipment & consumables procurement, demand for funds, submission of Utilization Certificates, etc. Track drug procurement and ensure timely availability and logistics for therapy. Guide and monitor ABHA ID generation and digital health record maintenance. Ensure timely and accurate data reporting and analytics for MoHFW and internal reviews. Organize capacity-building sessions, trainings and awareness programmes at the CoE. Develop and disseminate IEC materials and media content for public and stakeholder awareness. Support development of treatment guidelines, SOPs and other technical documentation. Manage patient data and regularly update the Rare Disease Registry and associated digital platforms. Assist in preparation of reports, summaries and digital dashboards. Maintain proper patient records in both digital and physical formats, ensuring confidentiality. Provide counseling, guidance and continuous support to rare disease patients and their caregivers.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring the duly filled application form in the prescribed format (attached to the notice) to the interview. Incomplete applications or applications without the prescribed format will not be considered. The form asks for personal details, category, age as on the last date of application, whether age relaxation is required, addresses, mobile number, email, qualifications from 10th class onwards, experience (newest to oldest) and any other information related to Public Health / Rare Diseases / Government Health Schemes work. Self-attested copies of all documents (one set). Proof of date of birth (class 10th certificate). Eligibility qualification mark-sheets and degrees. Experience certificates (minimum 5 years in the Public Health Sector). Category certificate for age relaxation (SC/ST/OBC). Other relevant testimonials. Two recent passport-size colour photographs. No Objection Certificate from the current employer (if in government service). Original documents for verification. A candidate who does not bring the original certificates, two photographs and one set of self-attested photocopies will not be allowed to participate in the interview.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The selection committee will conduct a walk-in interview for the post of Technical Coordinator (I). If a large number of eligible candidates appear, the committee may shortlist candidates through an MCQ based written test conducted on the day of the interview, and only the shortlisted candidates shall be interviewed. The final merit shall be prepared based on the marks obtained in the selection process. The interview is held only by appearing personally at the venue; there is no provision for an online interview. Any candidate found ineligible at any stage would not be allowed to proceed for the interview. No TA/DA will be given for appearing in the selection process or for joining the post. The result will be displayed on the AIIMS Bhopal website, and the selected candidate must join within seven days of the issue of the Offer letter.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the AIIMS Bhopal Technical Coordinator (I) walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026; candidates should report by 9:30 am at Lecture Theatre 1, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Bhawan, AIIMS Bhopal.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Technical Coordinator (I), reserved as UR.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in public health / Community Medicine / Health Management / Hospital Management / Public Health Informatics and related subjects OR MSW or equivalent from a recognized university, with at least 5 years' experience in the Public Health Sector, plus familiarity with Public Health Systems (Rare Diseases) and Government Health Schemes.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 45 years as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q5. Who gets age relaxation?
faq.answer: SC/ST/OBC candidates and departmental candidates (including projects) get age relaxation as per Central Government/MoHFW instructions, subject to submitting the category document with the original application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the Technical Coordinator (I)?
faq.answer: The pay is ₹60,000/- per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Through a walk-in interview; if many eligible candidates appear, an MCQ based written test may be held the same day for shortlisting, and the final merit is based on marks obtained in the selection process.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring?
faq.answer: The filled application form, original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies (date of birth, qualification, experience, category), two recent passport-size colour photographs and, if in government service, an NOC from the current employer.

faq.question: Q9. Is the post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely contractual for one year, extendable as per CoE requirement and subject to fund availability under NPRD, 2021, with no regularization or absorption.

faq.question: Q10. Is there an application fee or TA/DA?
faq.answer: The application fee is Nil, and no TA/DA will be given for attending the interview or joining the post.
